achievements.description: Win all 3 rounds in a single match.
Win a match after trailing in score after round 1.

_notes.persistence_warning: server.js currently identifies players by ephemeral deviceUUID/socket — there is no durable account yet (per the Play Store strategy doc's Phase 3 gating). Achievements can be evaluated PER-MATCH right now (e.g. round_sweep, perfect_catch), but anything meant to persist ACROSS matches/sessions (like a running catch-count total) needs Firebase Auth + a real User record first, or it will reset every reconnect.
needs_persistent_accounts: first_catch (if meant as lifetime-first, not match-first)
